full_page.content:
1933, December
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. S.
Page 165
Dec. 21st. Went to Emmet To-day on begging tour. Had dinner with Rev. Fr. Farrell class-mate of Fr. J. Lillian Rose - 60 - Goiter like neck
Dec. 24 Joseph Mercurio - 37 - has wife and 2 small children - totally blind now 13 months ..
27 Margaret Ellis - 28 - heart trouble - sore feet, etc. Prayed for two weeks ago - quite improved but still ....?
Algers boy - 4 - fever ??? - Father prayed for some weeks ago - coming O.K. now .. Catherine Tracey - 50 - malignant groth feared.
27 Fred T. Gould - 32 - skin infection Little Girl 3 - hoped to be home for Xmas much better.
Page 166
Dec. 29 Fred Alders - 4 - sinus & fever - still feverish though last Wed. after services became normal for a time. Enrolled at 9:30 p.m. perpetually
30 Mrs. Eva Dupurs - 34 - Fears she has cancer of stomach. Has 8 children to care for. Had one operation in October, pains con- tinue as before. Enrolled To-day 50c
Barth Remillard - 31 - fell about year ago has head-aches since seemingly worse of late. Enrolls To-day 50c
Olive Desmier - cancer of intestines.
John Flynn - 52 - "Chicago dispensary" becoming very weak.
Jeannette Bowman - 27 - extremely nervous - on that account had to be rejected from convent .... Mother anxious on her account.
James Mahaffy -6 next Sunday Jan. 7 - March 27th last most fear- fully & hopelessly burned ... Ist time prayed for started to eat after 5 days ..... 2nd time prayed for grafting of skin 100% suc- cessful - like miraculous. This was after Ist attempt - total failure. Now hip seems out of joint or infected.
Hannah McIntyre - 65 - feared has serious cancer.
